'''Voss-Ka''' was the [[Mountain/Legends|mountaintop]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Voss|same name]].<ref name="VossScreen" /> The city was fortified and defended by [[Voss commandos|commandos]] and [[Voss Mystics]] against the attacks of the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], who viewed the Voss as an abomination.<ref name="HoloVoss" /> The city housed the [[Tower of Prophecy]], as well as the embassies of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="VossScreen" /> established after the failed [[Imperial Attack on Voss|conquest attempt]] by the empire.<ref name="HoloVoss" />

The Voss were said to be great lovers of art who had developed a distinct style had been in existence for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] circa [[3653 BBY]].<ref>{{TORweb|url=media/screens/voss-1|text=Voss}}</ref> The architecture of Voss-Ka followed this distinctive style.<ref name="VossScreen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Voss-Ka was first mentioned on the [http://www.swtor.com Star Wars: The Old Republic] media website with the announcement of the planet Voss.<ref name="HoloVoss" /> The name of the settlement was provided along with a screenshot of the city in-game.<ref name="VossScreen" />
